image_description: An outdoor agricultural scene featuring three people operating a walk-behind tractor (two-wheel tractor) equipped with a moldboard plow attachment. The machine is actively tilling dark brown soil in a field with dry stubble. The background consists of dense green trees and foliage under daylight conditions.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The feet of the leftmost person appear to blend into the dark soil without a sharp contact shadow or clear boundary between shoe and ground, indicating slight edge bleeding or fusion.
